name: Unsolved Case: Whispers of Elderwick Collector’s Edition
description:
About This Game

Unsolved Case: Whispers of Elderwick Collector’s Edition is a psychological hidden-object mystery set in a quiet English countryside where fear settles deeper with every sunset. When a blood-chilling scream tears through the stillness of your peaceful village, retired librarian Mavis Donahue — sharp-minded, stubborn, and cursed with fleeting visions of the past — is pulled into a web of lies strangling her tight-knit community.

A neighbor is found dead. Forged letters begin appearing in mailboxes. Someone rifles through porches after dark. And behind lace-curtained windows, whispers grow: The village isn’t safe anymore.

Paired with Detective Marcus Partridge, Mavis follows trembling footprints through lantern-lit alleyways, shuttered corner shops, locked greenhouses, and misty cottage gardens where something far more dangerous than foxes prowls. What starts as a tragic death soon reveals a calculated plan to bleed the village dry — letter by letter, threat by threat, body by body.

To uncover the truth, you must unravel visions hidden inside everyday objects, decrypt a trail of manipulated mail, and navigate a community where every neighbor has something to hide.

Someone in the village is smiling politely… and plotting murder.

Features:

🔹 Explore atmospheric hidden-object scenes set in cottages, gardens, teahouses, greenhouses, and shadowy English lanes.

🔹 Unlock secret compartments, repair broken mechanisms, and restore key evidence hidden inside ordinary household items.

🔹 Solve story-driven puzzles and mini-games that reveal fragments of Mavis’s visions and expose forged letters, buried motives, and long-held grudges.

🔹 Meet villagers who shape your path — anxious Mimi, determined Marcus, jittery Arthur, and prickly Albert — each encounter changing who you can trust.

🔹 Collect hidden memories, tokens, and village curios to unlock bonus lore and achievements.

🔹 Play the Bonus Chapter and return to the village to uncover who helped orchestrate the scheme from the shadows.

And as the shadows thicken, only one question remains: will you uncover the truth before the darkness chooses its next victim?
short_desc: A killer hides behind familiar faces. Solve puzzles, uncover hidden clues, and expose the conspiracy tearing the village apart before fear consumes it whole.
